research_mode: Fresh web research plus rolling competitor registry continuity. Previous generated narrative reports were not used as analytical ground truth.

additions_or_newly_relevant.name: FX Auto Convert
additions_or_newly_relevant.why_it_matters: Recently added all-sites extension with inline/tooltip/replace modes. It proves new entrants keep appearing and that all-sites host permissions create trust risk.

additions_or_newly_relevant.name: Converter.app Currency Converter Browser Extension
additions_or_newly_relevant.why_it_matters: Reddit launch on April 16, 2026 frames the pain as travel planning and context switching, with a right-click overlay and historical charts.

additions_or_newly_relevant.name: Open-source Frankfurter-powered currency converter extension
additions_or_newly_relevant.why_it_matters: Reddit launch emphasizes no ads, no weird permissions and open-source trust; this is the trust copy FX Inline must beat.

additions_or_newly_relevant.name: Stripe Adaptive Pricing / FX Quotes / manual localized prices
additions_or_newly_relevant.why_it_matters: Stripe validates the buyer problem and will absorb many checkout-localization use cases. FX Inline must sell pre-checkout/pricing-page learning, not pretend to replace Stripe.

additions_or_newly_relevant.name: Paddle localized pricing
additions_or_newly_relevant.why_it_matters: Paddle explicitly frames local prices as trust and payment-acceptance improvement. FX Inline can borrow that business language for pricing-page hints.

competitors.name: Currency.Wiki Extension/Web/Document Pro
competitors.pricing: $7.95/mo Extension Pro, $3.99/mo Web Pro, $14.99/mo Document Pro, paid credit packs
competitors.traction: Currency.Wiki claims 50k+ Chrome extension users on its extension page; Chrome Web Store snippets also show a 60k-user widget listing. Pricing page shows Stripe billing and clear free-to-paid limits.
does_better: Trust assets including company identity and legal pages
does_worse: AI-scan positioning may be overkill for simple price hints
competitors.fx_inline_action: Do not copy the breadth. Copy the explicit free/paid boundaries and trust surface after the B2B wedge works.

competitors.name: Chrome Currency Converter / BestPrice Assistant
competitors.traction: Chrome listing showed 40,000 users and about 1.6K ratings at 3.5/3.6 depending on listing view.
competitors.fx_inline_action: Do not compete head-on for generic consumer utility. Use feature gaps as a review-mining source.

competitors.name: Universal Automatic Currency Converter
competitors.traction: Chrome-Stats shows 6,000 users, 4.22 rating, 118 reviews; Chrome listing also shows 7,000 users in fresh store view.
does_worse: Some CPU/memory complaints in Firefox reviews
competitors.fx_inline_action: Copy site controls and original visibility; avoid settings complexity.

competitors.name: PriceTip
competitors.traction: Chrome listing shows 6k-7k users and about 4.6 rating across localized views.
does_worse: Stopped-working/Invalid Date complaints from review mining
competitors.fx_inline_action: Borrow hover simplicity for consumer UX; avoid coercive review prompts and coverage gaps.

competitors.name: Cresotech Currency Converter
competitors.traction: Chrome-Stats shows 1,000 users and 4.47 rating from 49 reviews.
does_better: Hover-based conversion with very simple UX
competitors.fx_inline_action: Simplicity beats feature sprawl; never annoy users for ratings.

competitors.name: Xe Currency Converter & Price Switcher
competitors.pricing: Free, tied to Xe money-transfer/API ecosystem
competitors.traction: Xe has strong brand trust; official page emphasizes 130+ currencies, mid-market rates, and privacy.
does_worse: Extension itself is not necessarily the main revenue product
competitors.fx_inline_action: Copy privacy and rate-source clarity; FX Inline cannot outbrand Xe.

competitors.name: MLV Multi Country Pricing
competitors.traction: Shopify listing shows 405 reviews and 4.5 rating in fresh view; review summary praises multi-country pricing, setup and support.
does_worse: A negative current review mentions no contact, incompatibility and lost international orders
competitors.fx_inline_action: This is the better business category to learn from: sell outcome, support and setup, not generic conversion.

competitors.name: Stripe localized prices
competitors.pricing: Stripe fees and conversion fees; not a standalone extension
competitors.traction: Official docs present Adaptive Pricing as recommended and low-complexity for checkout localization.
does_worse: Does not solve public pricing-page comprehension before checkout in every custom site
competitors.fx_inline_action: Position FX Inline before checkout and as a learning layer, not as a payment processor.

competitors.name: Paddle localized pricing
competitors.traction: Official docs connect local currencies to trust, bank fees and payment approval.
does_worse: Only helps teams using Paddle or willing to implement Paddle pricing
competitors.fx_inline_action: Borrow the trust/payment-confidence narrative; sell low-effort pricing-page experiments.

competitors.name: ExchangeRate-API
competitors.traction: Official page emphasizes 165 currencies, uptime and support.
does_better: Commodity rate infrastructure with uptime/support posture
does_worse: Does not solve UX or pricing-page conversion alone
competitors.fx_inline_action: Do not build a commodity rate API; buy/use reliable rates and sell the UX/business outcome.

competitors.name: currencyapi.com
competitors.traction: Pricing page exposes normal API economics: requests, update frequency, support and commercial use.
does_worse: Commodity market with low entry price
competitors.fx_inline_action: API access is not a first-revenue wedge for FX Inline.

competitors.name: In-line Currency Converter Firefox
competitors.pricing: Free with buy-me-a-coffee style donation link
competitors.traction: Firefox listing shows 29 users and 4.0 rating from 6 reviews.
competitors.fx_inline_action: Consumer donation can exist but should not drive strategy.

competitors.name: Converter.app Currency Converter Browser Extension
competitors.pricing: Not verified as paid in this run
competitors.traction: Reddit launch on April 16, 2026 with Chrome and Firefox links.
does_better: Historical charts linked to existing platform
competitors.fx_inline_action: New entrants are using story-led launches; FX Inline should use concrete before/after demos, not generic feature lists.

competitors.name: Open-source Frankfurter-powered extension
competitors.fx_inline_action: Trust copy is table stakes; revenue needs a buyer with budget.
